# Mikhail Semenov, Product Manager

Product manager in B2B SaaS, open to work and available to start immediately (no
notice period). At Zvonobot (Prof-IT Group) from February 2022 to October 2026, where
he launched the voice AI agent line from zero in the fall of 2025: 80 paying B2B
customers and 500,000+ minutes of live conversations in production in under a year.
Owned pricing, unit economics and go-to-market; prototypes with AI coding agents
(Claude Code, Codex) so hypotheses get tested in days.

## Role and focus
- Title: Product Manager (B2B SaaS, voice AI agents, LLM)
- Status: open to work, can start immediately, no notice period
- Most recent role: Product Manager at Zvonobot, Prof-IT Group (February 2022 to October 2026); launched the AI agent line in fall 2025 and ran it until October 2026
- Team at Zvonobot: 4 engineers; a sales team that grew from 4 to 15 to sell the line
- Looking for: Product Manager or Product Owner roles in B2B SaaS, payments and AI products; full-time or contract
- Languages: Russian (native), English B2 (written work and documentation daily, confident on work calls)
- Work format: remote, GMT+5, open to relocation
